explanation: This unit tracks how late it is in the episode: it is 0 at every step until about trial 70, and after that it is highest at GO, rising from about 2-4 near trial 75 to 4-5 near trial 85 and 9-10 from trial 92 on. In the last ~10 trials D1 is moderate at about 3-8 (higher after a rewarded trial and later on), and D2 is lower at about 1-3 when S2 is reached and 3-7 when S1 is reached, while before trial 85 D1 and D2 stay at 0-2.
